newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well established, but few dressed sales steady, USDA said. Buyer inquiry decent. Seller interest somewhat limited as the bulk of this week's showlists already traded.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs 104.00, few 105.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 104.00, few 105.00.
